source.notes: Scanned school examination paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Header printed: 'GRADE VIII', 'SCHOOL' (placeholder, no school name), 'ASSESSMENT II', 'BIOLOGY', 'TIME:2 HOURS', 'M.M:40'. No year is printed; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name (...-150323-2023) and the icseboard.org folder. Section A (20 marks, attempt all): Questions I and II carry [2.5] each and are kept together as one 5-mark entry; Questions III-V carry one group mark [5] each and are kept whole (marks are never split). Section B: 'Attempt any four question' out of six (VI-XI), each with a) [2] and b) [3]; choiceGroup is not used for this any-four choice, so the listed marks add up to 50 against M.M 40. The third Section B question is printed 'IX' (struck through, 'VIII' handwritten) and is stored as VIII. Handwritten marks/ticks on the scan were ignored. No answer key.

questions.text:
I. Choose the correct option.
1. Nitrogen deficiency of soil can be removed by
a) Manuring b) Broadcasting c) Transplantation d) Applying urea
2.Which of the following disease occurs in dirty areas
a) Malaria b) Rabies c) AIDS d) Anaemia
3.Pairs of spinal nerves present in human being
a) 31 pairs b) 12 pairs c) 24 pairs d) 10 pairs
4. The habit which leads to hypertension:
a) Having processed food b) Having high salt diet c) Being physically inactive d) All of these
5. Which one of the following is a growth phase in human beings
a) Pupa b) Foetus c) Infancy d) Embryo
II. Name the hormones secreted by the following glands:
i)Thyroid b) Pancreas. c) Adrenal cortex d) Posterior pituitary e) Anterior pituitary
extractionIssues: Questions I and II each carry a printed group mark of [2.5]; the marks field holds whole numbers only, so the two are kept together as one 5-mark entry (no mark is printed per item)
